summary: Verified the admin quote-price edit bug fix. Backend PATCH /api/admin/bookings/{id}/quote-price correctly writes quote.approved_price (keeping quote.total_price for audit) and updates booking customer fields. Both admin dashboard modals (Pending Payments AND All Jobs) now read approved_price ?? total_price at both the per-card display and the top-of-modal totals, so the card visually updates the moment onSaved refetches — the reported bug is fixed. Ran 6 pytest backend tests (all pass) + 2 Playwright E2E flows (both pass, card price visibly updated $180→$299 in Pending Payments and $299→$550 in All Jobs without any page refresh).

integration_issues.issue: PATCH /api/admin/bookings/{id}/quote-price returned to the browser after ~22-23s (curl completes in <1s and Pending Payments flow completes in <1s). During that window the Save button correctly stays disabled/'Saving…' and the modal stays open, so no data loss — but the perceived latency is very poor. Likely a browser HTTP/2 connection or serialization delay tied to concurrent periodic admin GETs; worth a repro/profile on prod ingress.

issues: Pickup Date input silently displays empty (mm/dd/yyyy) when the booking.pickup_date in Mongo is stored as an ISO datetime string like '2026-07-25T00:00:00' instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Browser console prints: 'The specified value "2026-07-25T00:00:00" does not conform to the required format, "yyyy-MM-dd"'. Backend safely ignores empty strings so no data is wiped, but the admin can't see the current date. Suggest normalising pickup_date to YYYY-MM-DD before setForm({...}).

action_items: Investigate the intermittent ~22s latency on PATCH /api/admin/bookings/{id}/quote-price when triggered from the All Jobs edit flow (Pending Payments flow is fast; direct curl is fast). Possibly a connection-pool / periodic-refetch collision.
Normalise booking.pickup_date to YYYY-MM-DD (strip 'T…') in EditBookingModal's useEffect so the date field is prefilled correctly in the admin edit dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: EditBookingModal.jsx passes pickup_date straight into a type=date input; sanitise ISO datetimes to YYYY-MM-DD or the field silently blanks and any admin edit that doesn't retype the date submits an empty string (backend then skips it, so no data loss, but a subtle UX foot-gun).

PaymentRemindersModal.js and AllJobsModal.js correctly use `quote_details?.approved_price ?? quote_details?.total_price ?? 0` at both the reducer (totalDue / totalRevenue) and card-price sites — fix is symmetric and complete.

rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: cards rendered `quote_details.total_price` only, but the PATCH endpoint stores the admin-edited price on `quote.approved_price` (leaving `total_price` intact as an audit of the original AI quote). After the fix, both display sites and both totals-reducers use `approved_price ?? total_price ?? 0`, so as soon as the parent refetch (fetchPendingPayments / fetchAllJobs) resolves, the card re-renders with the new price. Backend `_compute_booking_amount_due` already prefers `approved_price`, so booking.amount_due is consistent.
